task.description: The name of the benchmark task (e.g., task_01_typed_function)

language.description: The programming language being benchmarked (e.g., howlframe, go, python, node)

track.description: Track A (Language generation) or Track B (Agentic development)

model.description: The AI model used for generation (e.g., gemini-1.5-pro, gpt-4o)

first_pass_success.description: Did the very first generated code pass all tests?

eventual_success.description: Did it eventually pass all tests after repairs?

repair_attempts.description: Number of repair attempts (0 if first pass succeeded)

total_generated_tokens.description: Total output tokens generated by the model across all attempts. Null if unavailable.

final_source_tokens.description: Token count of the final correct source code using cl100k_base or similar standard.

elapsed_time_seconds.description: Wall-clock time from start of prompt to verified artifact, in seconds.

verification_commands_run.description: Total number of build/test/verification commands executed during the process.

code_churn_lines.description: Total lines added/removed during repair phases. Null if not tracked.

runtime_backend.description: The runtime or backend used (e.g., HowlFrame VM, Go 1.22, Node 20).

capability_denial_behavior.description: Description of how the code handled restricted capabilities, if applicable to the task.

deterministic_repeatability.description: Result of deterministic repeatability check (e.g., identical outputs on 5 runs), if applicable.

notes.description: Any manual notes, anomalies, or limitations observed during this run.
